title: Kyrgyzstan Discovery Tour
introduction: A ten-day route through Kyrgyzstan combining Bishkek, alpine lakes, nomadic culture, yurt stays, mountain scenery and local hospitality.
Highlights include Song Kul, traditional eagle hunting, Skazka Canyon, Altyn Arashan hot springs, Issyk-Kul and historic sites around the Chuy Valley.

image.alt: Traditional eagle hunting demonstration in Kyrgyzstan

highlights.title: Horse riding on the alpine steppe
The hot springs of Altyn Arashan

included: Entry fees for the mentioned sites
Meals according to the daily description

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bishkek
itinerary.description: Arrive in Bishkek, meet the guide for a welcome briefing and orientation, enjoy free time, then join an evening dinner and traditional folklore concert.

itinerary.title: Ala Archa & Bishkek City Tour
itinerary.description: Visit Ala Archa National Park for mountain scenery and glacial landscapes, then return to Bishkek for a city tour covering markets, monuments and Soviet-era boulevards.

itinerary.title: Bishkek - Kochkor - Song Kul
itinerary.description: Travel south through Kochkor and climb toward high-altitude Song Kul Lake, where nomadic summer camps spread across the surrounding grasslands.
itinerary.accommodation: Yurt camp (up to 4 people per yurt)

itinerary.title: Full Day at Song Kul
itinerary.description: Spend the day around Song Kul, including a two-hour horse ride and free time for relaxing or optional hiking along the lakeshore.
itinerary.accommodation: Yurt camp (up to 4 people per yurt)

itinerary.title: Song Kul - Kochkor - Bokonbaevo
itinerary.description: Descend from Song Kul, see a traditional yurt-building demonstration, share lunch in a Kochkor homestay and continue along Issyk-Kul toward Bokonbaevo.
itinerary.accommodation: Yurt camp (up to 4 people per yurt)

itinerary.title: Eagle Hunting - Skazka Canyon - Barskoon - Karakol
itinerary.description: Experience an eagle-hunting demonstration, visit Skazka Canyon and Barskoon Valley, then continue to Karakol for a city tour and local meals.

itinerary.title: Altyn Arashan Hot Springs
itinerary.description: Travel into the Altyn Arashan valley for an overnight mountain stay and time at its natural thermal springs.

itinerary.title: Altyn Arashan - Cholpon-Ata
itinerary.description: Descend to the northern shore of Issyk-Kul and visit Cholpon-Ata, including the open-air Petroglyphs Museum and time by the lake.

itinerary.title: Cholpon-Ata - Burana - Bishkek
itinerary.description: Return toward Bishkek via Burana Tower, with an opportunity to experience Kok Boru and share lunch in a homestay before the final overnight in Bishkek.

itinerary.title: Departure from Bishkek
itinerary.description: Transfer to the airport for the departure flight.
